description_en: Dynamically generates an Alibaba Cloud CLI command
kebab_example: aliyun openapiexplorer generate-cli-command --product Ecs --biz-api-version 2014-05-26 --api DescribeRegions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-params key=example-string --json-api-params '{"InstanceChargeType":"PostPaid","ResourceType":"instance","AcceptLanguage":"en-US"}' --aggregate-pagination true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateCLICommand

parameters.help_en:
The product code.

Call the GetRequestLog operation to obtain the product code from the response.

Find the product code from the URL of the OpenAPI portal. For example, <props="china">the OpenAPI portal URL for Short Message Service is https://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi. Based on this URL, the product code for Short Message Service is Dysmsapi.</props>
<props="intl">the OpenAPI portal URL for Short Message Service is https://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi. Based on this URL, the product code for Short Message Service is Dysmsapi.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
产品CODE。

调用GetRequestLog接口，从返回结果中获取产品CODE。

通过OpenAPI门户的URL，找到对应的产品CODE。例如，<props="china">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
<props="intl">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
parameters.name: product

parameters.help_en: The API input parameters in JSON format. This parameter has a lower priority than apiParams. If apiParams is specified, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: JSON格式的API入参，优先级低于apiParams，当apiParams设置时，此参数无效
parameters.name: json_api_params

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the aggregation feature. If enabled, the CLI automatically reads full data in a paged manner and aggregates the results.

<warning>This option can be used only for List-type operations that support pagination.</warning>

true: enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用聚合能力，若开启，CLI会自动以分页的方式读取全量数据并对结果聚合。

<warning>只有支持分页的List类型的接口才能使用这个开关。</warning>

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: aggregate_pagination
